run_lengths_cosine_coherence_benchmark: run the lengths cosine coherence benchmark using TensorComprehensions with configurable segment and channel parameters
run_reference_cosine_coherence: run the reference numpy implementation of lengths cosine coherence to validate TC output
run_TC_make_alpha: run the TC make_alpha function to compute triangular positive and negative pair indicators
run_TC_normalize: run the TC normalize function to L2-normalize input embeddings along the channel dimension
run_TC_make_counts: run the TC make_counts function to count positive and negative pairs per segment
